ms.promise: ・Implement auto-sign support in at least 1 game using Paima
ms.criteria: ・At least one game built with Paima that implements the auto-sign functionality
ms.report:
**Context:** Paima Studios merged into the Midnight Foundation, and Paima Engine was rebranded as EffectStream. We have rewritten the entire codebase from scratch - this is the third version. We listened to feedback, followed better practices, and improved overall quality. These events are why we are delivering now, but everything has been updated for the present. The auto-sign functionality was originally proposed as a Metamask Snap (M3). The delivered solution uses `@effectstream/wallets`, a multi-chain wallet package with session key delegation - a more flexible approach that works across wallet types and is live in 3 production games. Even though we have delivered with `@effectstream/wallets`, the original Paima Engine auto-sign specification and approach is available at https://github.com/PaimaStudios/paima-engine. This Milestone is provided after the fact, so it contains further reach than M4. New site https://effectstream.github.io/home/

**A. Output: At least one game implementing auto-sign functionality**
Acceptance criteria: At least one game built with the framework that implements auto-sign. Delivered with three live production games on midnight.fun, all using session key delegation via `@effectstream/wallets` to eliminate wallet pop-ups for non-financial interactions. Players approve delegation once, then play without interruption. The session key model is scoped (non-financial only), time-bounded, and revocable.
Evidence:
- Safe Solver: https://safesolver.midnight.fun/
-And other games in midnight.fun site
**B. Output: Release announcement of the integration**
Acceptance criteria: Public announcement of the auto-sign feature with demonstration of the integration.
Evidence:
- Blog post: https://effectstream.github.io/docs/blog/auto-sign
- Midnight Network blog (announcement featuring all 3 games): https://midnight.network/blog/introducing-midnight-fun
- Twitter/X @MidnightNtwrk: https://x.com/MidnightNtwrk/status/2043388660188385620
